Package com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository

Class EventRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository.EventRepository
public class EventRepository extends Object
Handles all Firestore read and write operations for the events collection. Uses FirebaseConnector to obtain collection references.

  • Method Details

    • addEvent

      public void addEvent(Event event, EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<String> callback)
      Adds a new event to Firestore. Firestore generates the document ID, which is then written back into the event and persisted as the eventId field.
      Parameters:
      event - the event to save
      callback - receives the new Firestore document ID on success

    • getEventById

      public void getEventById(String eventId, EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<Event> callback)
      Fetches a single event by its Firestore document ID.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore document ID of the event
      callback - receives the Event on success, or null if not found

    • getAllEvents

      public void getAllEvents(EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<List<Event>> callback)
      Fetches all events from the events collection.
      Parameters:
      callback - receives the list of all Event objects on success

    • updateEvent

      public void updateEvent(Event event, EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<Void> callback)
      Overwrites an existing event document with the provided event's data. Fails immediately if the event has no eventId set.
      Parameters:
      event - the event to update; must have a non-empty eventId
      callback - receives null on success

    • getEventsByOrganizerId

      public void getEventsByOrganizerId(String organizerId, EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<List<Event>> callback)
      Fetches all events created by a specific organizer.
      Parameters:
      organizerId - the device ID of the organizer
      callback - receives the list of matching Event objects on success

    • deleteEvent

      public void deleteEvent(String eventId, EventRepository.FirestoreCallback<Void> callback)
      Deletes an event document from Firestore.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore document ID of the event to delete
      callback - receives null on success
